text: {"rules":[],"notes":"M.G.L. c. 186, § 12 sets notice periods for ending a tenancy at will: three months' notice, or a rent-interval/30-day notice, or 14 days' notice to quit for nonpayment with a 10-day cure right. It does not limit terminations to listed causes, and it has no relocation assistance. It is a general termination-procedure rule, not a just-cause eviction rule. The document also covers no rent increase limits, security deposits, application fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic pricing, so no in-scope rule is extracted."}
